tieng_Anh: Additionally, the difference in the ATK is taken out of the losing player's Life Points.

tieng_Anh: In the previous battle, your attacking monster had 800 ATK.\nThe monster being attacked had 500 ATK.

800-500=300

800-500=300

tieng_Anh: Your opponent's Life Points was originally 8000.\n8000-300=7700\nSo your opponent now has 7700 Life Points.
